title: Offline or 5xx for days refuses Disconnect for days
evidence: S50b: offline or 5xx for days means Disconnect is refused for days; design with Part 2 (e.g. the refusal lifts after N failed tries over a stated time into Part 2's confirm). Accepted for Part 1 by the owner. Also (PR 1751 review, folded in by the owner 2026-11-14): over-hold. The erase can land through a save that never calls pending.clear (RecordSession mirrorSkipped, or a save that lands after its claim ended, record-session.ts ~:448-456), so Open.held stays set; a weight edit that then fails over an outage reads transient and Disconnect shows the erase words, which are false then. It clears once the cloud answers. Fix: clear held when a save lands whose working copy holds the erase, not only in pending.clear.
